name: YASHA ~Kakusareta Kyouki~
source:
Main character's father remarries bringing new family to live together. But everything changes with father's overseas assignment. Stepmother starts to bully protagonist and his sister feeling jealousy. Hero stands up on the way of revenge.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角的父亲再婚，并让新家庭与他们共同生活。然而，父亲被派往海外后，一切都发生了变化。继母因为嫉妒，开始欺负主角和他的妹妹。男主角踏上了复仇之路。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
